questions.questionHtml:
Which two numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : 7 and 2

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 2 + 56 ÷ 8 × 7 - 13 = 11

⇒ 2 + 56 ÷ 8 × 7 - 13 = 11

⇒ 2 + 7 × 7 - 13 = 11

⇒ 2 + 49 - 13 = 11

⇒ 51 - 13 = 11

⇒ 38 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 8 and 2

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 7 + 56 ÷ 2 × 8 - 13 = 11

⇒ 7 + 56 ÷ 2 × 8 - 13 = 11

⇒ 7 + 28 × 8 - 13 = 11

⇒ 7 + 224 - 13 = 11

⇒ 231 - 13 = 11

⇒ 218 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 7 and 13

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 13 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 - 7 = 11

⇒ 13 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 - 7 = 11

⇒ 13 + 7 × 2 - 7 = 11

⇒ 13 + 14 - 7 = 11

⇒ 27 - 7 = 11

⇒ 20 ≠ 11

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 7 and 8

Given equation : 7 + 56 ÷ 8 × 2 – 13 = 11

After interchanging the numbers in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 8 + 56 ÷ 7 × 2 - 13 = 11

⇒ 8 + 56 ÷ 7 × 2 - 13 = 11

⇒ 8 + 8 × 2 - 13 = 11

⇒ 8 + 16 - 13 = 11

⇒ 24 - 13 = 11

⇒ 11 = 11

LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "7 and 8".

⇒ Saurabh = 10 years

Similarly,

Hence, the correct answer is "43".

Similarly,

questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the given equation correct. 88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and make the given equation correct.

88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : +, ÷ , – , = , × 

Given equation : 88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 88 + 120 ÷ 42 - 240 = 48 × 2

⇒ 88 + 120 ÷ 42 - 240 = 48 × 2

⇒ 88 + 2.8571 - 240 = 48 × 2

⇒ 88 + 2.8571 - 240 = 96

⇒ 90.8571 - 240 = 96

⇒ - 149.1428 ≠ 96

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : =, × , +, ÷, –

Given equation : 88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 88 = 120 × 42 + 240 ÷ 48 - 2

⇒ 88 = 120 × 42 + 240 ÷ 48 - 2

⇒ 88 = 120 × 42 + 5 - 2

⇒ 88 = 5040 + 5 - 2

⇒ 88 = 5045 - 2

⇒ 88 ≠ 5043

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ×, ÷, =, –, +

Given equation : 88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 88 × 120 ÷ 42 = 240 - 48 + 2

⇒ 88 × 120 ÷ 42 = 240 - 48 + 2

⇒ 88 × 2.8571 = 240 - 48 + 2

⇒ 251.4285 = 240 - 48 + 2

⇒ 251.4285 = 242 - 48

⇒ 251.4285 ≠ 194

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : =, –, +, ÷, × 

Given equation : 88 * 120 * 42 * 240 * 48 * 2

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 88 = 120 - 42 + 240 ÷ 48 × 2

⇒ 88 = 120 - 42 + 240 ÷ 48 × 2

⇒ 88 = 120 - 42 + 5 × 2

⇒ 88 = 120 - 42 + 10

⇒ 88 = 130 - 42

⇒ 88 = 88

LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "=, –, +, ÷, × ".

questions.question: ______ is defined as the temperature to which the air would have to cool (at constant pressure and constant water vapour content) in order to reach saturation.
questions.questionHtml: ______ is defined as the temperature to which the air would have to cool (at constant pressure and constant water vapour content) in order to reach saturation.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Dew point temperature.

Key Points

  • Dew point temperature (DPT):
    • It is a temperature at which moisture present in the atmosphere starts condensing or it is the temperature at which the first droplet of moisture is formed.
    • As we know that for each pressure, the air has a specific saturation temperature, therefore for fully saturated air DBT, WBT and DPT are equal.
    • When the relative humidity of the air is 100%, i.e the air is saturated, the dew point temperature (DPT) equals the wet-bulb temperature (WBT), which is also equal to the dry-bulb temperature.
    • So DBT = WBT = DPT

Additional Information

  • Relative humidity:
    • It is defined as the ratio of the mass of vapour to the mass of vapour under saturation conditions.
    • Relative humidity represents vapour absorption capacity.

questions.questionHtml: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then the length of PB (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P.

AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm

Concept used:

If two chords of a circle intersect externally, then the product of the lengths of the segments are equal

Calculation:

Let, PB = x cm

PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ x (x + 7) = 5 (5 + 1)

⇒ x2 + 7x = 30

⇒ x2 + 7x - 30 = 0

⇒ x2 + 10x - 3x - 30 = 0

⇒ x (x + 10) - 3 (x + 10) = 0

⇒ (x + 10) (x - 3) = 0

⇒ x + 10 = 0 ⇒ x = - 10 [Not possible]

⇒ x - 3 = 0 ⇒ x = 3

∴ The length of PB (in cm) is 3 cm

Shortcut Trick

Rate of interest = 10% (per annum)

Fraction value = 10% = 1/10

∴ Principal = 10; Interest = 1

So, total installment = 10 + 1 = 11

Time Period Principal

Equal instalment

per annum

2nd year 102 = 100 112 = 121
 

Total principal

= 110 + 100 = 210

  

 

So, 210 → Rs. 4620

∴ The each instalment (in Rs.) is Rs. 2662

Alternate Method

Given:

Total amount = Rs. 4620

Rate of interest = 10%

Total number of installment = 2

Formula used:

Installment = \(\frac{P}{\left(\frac{100}{100+R} \right)+\left(\frac{100}{100+R} \right)^n}\)

Calculation:

Installment = \(\frac{4620}{\left(\frac{100}{100+10} \right)+\left(\frac{100}{100+10} \right)^2}\)

= 4620/[(10/11) + (10/11)2]

= 4620/[(10/11) + (100/121)]

= 4620/(210/121)

= 4620 × (121/210)

= 2662

∴ The each instalment (in Rs.) is Rs. 2662

8A5146B is divisible by 88

So, 8A5146B is divisible by 8 and 11

⇒ 46B should be divisible by 8

Put B = 4, 464 is divisible by 8

Hence, B = 4

Now, 8A51464 should be divisible by 11

⇒ (8 + 5 + 4 + 4) - (A + 1 + 6) should be divisible by 11

⇒ 21 - (A + 7) should be divisible by 11

⇒ 14 - A should be divisible by 11

Put A = 3 then, 14 - 3 = 11 which is divisible by 11

So, A = 3

∴ AB = 3 × 4 = 12

∴ The value of AB is 12

Concept used:

If Two triangles are similar then, their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are within the same ratio (or proportion)

Calculation:

In ΔCAB and ΔCDA,

∠BAC = ∠ADC (Given)

∠ACB = ∠ACD (Common)

Then, CA/CB = CD/CA

⇒ 15/CB = 9/15

∴ The value of CB (in cm) is 25 cm

questions.question: A tyre has 3 punctures. The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 minutes, the second alone would have done it in 18 minutes, the third alone would have done it in 6 minutes. If the air leaks out at a constant rate, then how long (in minutes) does it take for all the punctures together to make it flat?
questions.questionHtml: A tyre has 3 punctures. The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 minutes, the second alone would have done it in 18 minutes, the third alone would have done it in 6 minutes. If the air leaks out at a constant rate, then how long (in minutes) does it take for all the punctures together to make it flat?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total efficiency = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6

The time required = 18/6 = 3 minutes

∴ All punctures can make the tyre flat in 3 minutes

Alternate Method

Given:

The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 minutes

The second puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 18 minutes

The third puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 6 minutes

Calculation:

In 1 minute, the first puncture can make (1/9)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the second puncture can make (1/18)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the third puncture can make (1/6)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the all tyres can make (1/9) + (1/18) + (1/6) = (1/3)th of the tyre flat

Total required time to flat = 3 minutes

∴ All punctures can make the tyre flat in 3 minutes

questions.question: The average of sixteen numbers is 48. The average of the first six of these numbers is 45 and that of the last seven numbers is 53. The seventh and the eighth numbers are, respectively, 3 and 7 greater than the ninth number. What is the average of the ninth and seventh numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The average of sixteen numbers is 48. The average of the first six of these numbers is 45 and that of the last seven numbers is 53. The seventh and the eighth numbers are, respectively, 3 and 7 greater than the ninth number. What is the average of the ninth and seventh numbers?
questions.solution:
Let, the ninth number = x, seventh number = x + 3 and eighth number = x + 7

Then, x + (x + 3) + (x + 7) = (16 × 48) - [(6 × 45) + (7 × 53)] 

⇒ 3x + 10 = 768 - (270 + 371) ⇒ 3x = 117 ⇒ x = 39

∴ The seventh number = 39 + 3 = 42 and required average = (39 + 42)/2 = 81/2 = 40.5

questions.question: A spends 65% of his income. His income is increased by 20.1% and the expenditure is increased by 20%. By what percent (correct to one decimal place) does his saving increase or decrease?
questions.questionHtml: A spends 65% of his income. His income is increased by 20.1% and the expenditure is increased by 20%. By what percent (correct to one decimal place) does his saving increase or decrease?
questions.solution:
Let Income = Rs. 100, Expenditure = Rs. 65; Savings = (100 - 65)% = 35%

New income = 100 + (20.1% of 100) = Rs. 120.1, New expenditure = 65 + (20% of 65) = Rs. 78

The new savings = 120.1 - 78 = Rs. 42.1

The gain percentage of savings = [(42.1 - 35)/35] × 100 = 20.28...% ≈ 20.3%
